mapper.select: SELECT dict_code, tenant_id, dict_sort, dict_label, dict_value, dict_type, css_class, list_class, is_default, dict_status, remark, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time, del_flag FROM sys_dict_data WHERE dict_type = #{dictType} AND dict_status = 1 AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY dict_sort ASC
